title: untimeout
description: Disable the default timeout for debugging
body:
This mod disables the timeout (default 30) to allow you to easier debug your server and use breakpoints to help debug.

# Features

Theres only 1. Completely disables the keep alive timeout so you can debug with ease!

# Credits

Inspiration from [TimeOutOut](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeoutout)
